title: C: Graph Traversal (BFS/DFS)
description: Implement a simple graph using adjacency lists and traverse it with BFS and DFS.

steps.title: Graph with DFS
steps.description: Define a graph with up to 6 nodes and edges. Implement DFS (recursive) that prints nodes in visitation order. Test with a small graph.
hints: Mark visited, print node, recurse on neighbors.

verification.failureMessage: Print DFS and BFS traversals starting from node 0
